newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to seek funds to help poor develop skills.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to seek funds to help poor develop skills.

text.p: The Clinton administration will propose a program to provide resources to state and local governments to help move people from welfare to work, Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said on Thursday.
He told a John F. Kennedy School forum that the program would help people develop the technical and social skills needed to prosper in the workplace and be "job-ready."

"That is a very important piece of what needs to be done. One of the programs we will be proposing in connection with moving people from welfare to work will provide resources that can be used by state and localities for that purpose," he said.
